negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.component: 프런트 도어 트림 / 1 Page Guide Manual
negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.finding: SST/장비 column exists but the shown rows contain dashes. H/W lists 파스너/스크류 for trim removal, which is hardware, not a complete list of tools or vehicle-part numbers.
negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.interpretation_limit: A dash in the SST/equipment column must not be interpreted as no tools required because the matching detailed procedure 46-4.pdf explicitly specifies a remover.

negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.finding: General bolt tightening table lists thread diameter M5 to M30, pitch mm and strength class-dependent tightening torques in kgf.m.
negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.interpretation_limit: Thread diameters/pitches and torque values are neither socket/spanner sizes nor replacement vehicle-part numbers. No specific socket size was verified by this tool survey.

negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.finding: Source includes a removable clip illustration but no orderable number beside it. General caution specifies remover and gloves.
negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.interpretation_limit: Do not infer clip part number from picture, component letter A or the source filename.

negative_and_ambiguous_evidence.finding: The metadata field part_number is a numeric source-file subindex such as 6 for 42-6.pdf, not an OEM replacement part number.

survey_counts_not_global_absence_claims.meaning: Counts refer to OCR matches. Lack of a match is not proof that image-only labeling or unrecognized text never contains the information. Confirmed exact entries are the manually verified examples above.

recommended_fact_boundaries_for_booklet: Publish confirmed general tool names and protective consumables together with their exact source procedure and location.
Show special tool catalog numbers as tool numbers and only assign them to the stated use.
Separate source-stated tools from inferred practical tool suggestions, sizes, and replacement part numbers still requiring confirmation.
Do not manufacture missing socket sizes, bit types, equipment models, replacement numbers, or all-task tool requirements.
